checkpoints.description: [1/4] Plan: add header seed and independently verify episode_sha256; opt-in claim-ref integration

impact_assessment.why: The header binds an episode digest computed from the initial state, task, seed, max_steps and policy digest, but it omits the seed. A verifier cannot rebuild the deterministic initial state and recompute the digest, so claim refs trust an unverified episode binding.
impact_assessment.benefits: write_header accepts seed; run_task_logged records it; verify_episode_header rebuilds GridWorld(task,seed).reset() and input_digest, returning ok/recomputed/mismatch findings; verify_claim_refs(verify_episodes=True) rejects a mismatched header; intact runs verify, wrong seed/episode and missing seed/header are named.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive header field and opt-in verifier/claim flag; dependency: worlds.grid + identity; concurrency: read-only; state: header schema additive, episode digest unchanged.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Default seed=None and verify_episodes=False for backward compatibility; validate the header fields; test intact/wrong-seed/wrong-episode/missing-seed/missing-header/malformed and the claim-ref integration; rerun 402 tests plus AIKit.

[1/4] Plan: optional expected-policy pin for episode and claim verification

impact_assessment.why: verify_episode_header recomputes with the stored policy_sha256, so a forged policy plus a matching episode digest passes internally. An external expected-policy pin (e.g. the current policy_digest) can reject a header claiming a different policy.
impact_assessment.benefits: verify_episode_header(log, expected_policy_sha256=...) and verify_claim_refs(..., expected_policy_sha256=..., verify_episodes=True) accept a 64-hex expected policy; a current run matches, a wrong expected value reports policy-mismatch, and a forged policy+episode passes without the pin but fails with it.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: optional verifier kwargs only, header/claim schema unchanged; dependency: identity/agent policy_digest; concurrency: read-only; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate the expected digest, require verify_episodes for claim refs, keep None as the old behavior, test current/wrong/forged/invalid/claims cases, and rerun 410 tests plus AIKit.

[1/4] Plan: enforce claim status/verdict consistency and verdict text validation

impact_assessment.why: Claims could load with a status contradicting their verdict history, and verdict evidence/timestamps were unvalidated; a checksum-valid forged snapshot could assert an unsupported status.
impact_assessment.benefits: Status is derived from the last verdict; inconsistent claims, empty verdict evidence/timestamps and forged-checksum store snapshots are rejected while consistent legacy payloads still load.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Claim/Verdict construction now validates, from_dict is stricter; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no schema change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Preserve proposed-with-no-verdicts and last-verdict status; test construction and load; keep legacy consistent payloads; run 420 tests and AIKit.
